summary: Iteration 20 – Payslip (Slip Gaji) reference layout. Backend (5/5 pytest) + Frontend (full E2E incl. PDF extraction) all PASS. Settings kota/penandatangan persist; Bonus/Pot.Lain dialog updates row & grand total immediately; save persists after reload; printed PDF filename Slip_Gaji_<name>_<Bulan>_<Tahun>.pdf and contains all required sections, correct net amount Rp 1.785.433 and terbilang 'Satu Juta Tujuh Ratus Delapan Puluh Lima Ribu Empat Ratus Tiga Puluh Tiga Rupiah'.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py (~1843 lines) is well past the 700-line guideline — consider splitting into routers (auth, products, payroll, ecommerce, attendance).

GET /api/payroll/settings is admin-aware via get_current_user but POST is admin-only; consistent, OK. _compute_payroll iterates all users with to_list(500) – fine for small shops; add pagination/index on attendance.date and ecommerce_sales.created_at for scale.

exporter.printPayslip builds PDF client-side; terbilang handles negative via 'Minus' prefix but final 'Rupiah' always appended – OK. Signature block uses fixed y+26 offset; if bonus list grows, pagination relies on `if y>240` only (works for current body).
No server-side validation on bonus_items keterangan length / jumlah max — malicious client could store huge strings; add length cap.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_PayslipUI kasir for UI test and TEST_Payslip for pytest – both deleted during teardown. Admin override for current month cleaned. Payroll settings reset to empty kota/penandatangan, potongan_telat=0, hari_kerja=26.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter20 covered backend payroll kota/ttd + bonus_items/potongan_lain and frontend Rekap Gaji dialog + payslip PDF (reference layout from Slip_Gaji Mulya Tani). PDF text extracted via pypdf verified all required labels and correct terbilang. employee_salary doc for TEST_PayslipUI may remain orphaned after user deletion (no API to remove) – harmless.
